Senses.Explanation: The one road of getting out is demanded after every polished answer has been smashed to pieces. Yuwang Duanyu asks for it, drops the whisk, and leaves the assembly with ‘investigate.’ A road becomes the interview’s exit from answers that remain shadow-work; even a ten-out-of-ten response is destroyed before this route is requested. The three witnesses transmit the same Duanyu case in distinct works, so they establish broad transmission of one case but not three independent deployments. All witnesses preserve the same direct demand for one exit road; no second object appears.
